definitions: A domain of single-celled microorganisms. These microbes are prokaryotes, meaning they have no cell nucleus or any other membrane-bound organelles in their cells.
Microorganisms that are genetically distinct from bacteria and eukaryotes, often thriving in extreme environments.
examples: Archaea are known for inhabiting extreme environments.
The study focused on the unique metabolic pathways of archaea.
Both bacteria and archaea are prokaryotes.
